verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs call it "an open source platform", and its source is published in the public github.com/pulumi/pulumi repository, so users can read the core code. The community remark about "your license" is too vague to contradict this. Missing for 10: the specific license (e.g. its name or terms) is never stated in the evidence, it is unclear whether Pulumi Cloud and other components are covered, and there is no independent confirmation of the license.
